name: Cooper's Restaurant (Fish Haven, ID) Pan-Seared Atlantic Salmon & Idaho Baked Potato
brandOrRestaurant: Cooper's Restaurant & Sports Bar (Fish Haven / Bear Lake West, ID)
whyItWorks: An elite flare-safe dinner overlooking Bear Lake. Fresh pan-seared Atlantic salmon is rich in anti-inflammatory omega-3 fatty acids, paired with smooth, easily digested Idaho baked potato flesh.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Pan-Seared Salmon with sea salt and olive oil, accompanied by an Idaho baked potato (eat the soft interior with butter, leave the tough potato skin uneaten).
watchOuts: Discard tough baked potato skin during flare periods
